{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mating Call''' was an ancient, [[Species/Legends|species]]-wide command felt by the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] when it was time to return to [[Barab I/Legends|Barab I]] to [[Reproduction/Legends|mate]]. As the mating call was impossible to ignore, many [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologists]] believed this was the reason that the Barabel continued to exist.
